realizes.rationale: Configures VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, full HTML title 'Riemann Hypothesis Proof Explainer' with compact themeConfig.siteTitle 'RH Proof Explainer', cleanUrls, locked light editorial appearance, MathJax 3 SVG math, and top nav plus Stage 00 (including Proof Journey), Stage 01 (4 pages) and Concept (18 slugs) sidebar navigation.

1.note: `normalizeBase` reads `VITEPRESS_BASE` with default `/ar-rh-proof-skeleton/` and enforces leading and trailing slashes.

2.note:
`defineConfig` sets `cleanUrls: true`, light-only `appearance: false` and `markdown.math: true` for build-time MathJax 3 SVG math.

Anchor: `defineConfig`

3.note:
`themeConfig` sets compact navbar `siteTitle: 'RH Proof Explainer'`, defines 6 top navigation links (including `Proof Journey` and `Stage 01`), Stage 00 (5 pages including `Full Proof Journey & 20-Step Map`), Stage 01 (4 pages under `/stages/01_reduction/`) and Foundational Concepts (index + 18 slugs) sidebar groups, `[2, 3]` outline and `ariaLabel`-annotated GitHub `socialLinks`.

Anchor: `themeConfig`
